We have search results. Need to identify which template corresponds to SNAr (halide replaced by amine). Look at each entry:

- reaction_id 639229: retro_smarts_template: '[C:6]-[CH2;D2;+0:5]-[#7:4]-[c:3]:[cH;D2;+0:1]:[c:2]>>F-[c;H0;D3;+0:1](:[c:2]):[c:3]-[#7:4]-[C;H0;D3;+0:5](=O)-[C:6]'. This seems to be a nucleophilic aromatic substitution where a fluorine on aromatic is replaced by a secondary amine attached via carbonyl? Actually the forward direction (retro) is breaking C-F bond and forming C-N bond? The retro template shows product side (left) is C-CH2-N-aryl? Wait retro_smarts_template is for retrosynthesis: it shows breaking a bond to generate precursors. The pattern: [C:6]-[CH2]-[#7:4]-[c:3]:[cH]:[c:2] >> F-[c]...-[#7:4]-[C](=O)-[C:6]. This seems like a SNAr where a fluorine attached to aromatic is replaced by a secondary amine attached to carbonyl? Might be relevant.

The mapped_rxn for this template is given. The product_smiles and reactant_smiles correspond to product (after SNAr) and reactants (precursors). The product_smiles: '[Cl:1][c:2]1[cH:3][cH:4][c:5](-[n:6]2[n:7][c:8]3[c:13]([c:14]2[CH:15]([CH2:16][NH:17][c:18]2[cH:19][cH:20][c:21](-[c:22]4[n:23][n:24][n:25][nH:26]4)[cH:27][cH:28]2)[CH:29]2[CH2:30][CH2:31][CH2:32][CH2:33][CH2:34]2)[CH2:12][CH2:11][CH2:10][CH2:9]3)[cH:35][cH:36]1'

That product contains a Cl attached to aromatic, not F. The reactant_smiles includes F on aromatic and a secondary amine (NH) attached to aromatic? Actually reactant_smiles: O=[C:16]([CH:15]([c:14]1[n:6](-[c:5]2[cH:4][cH:3][c:2]([Cl:1])[cH:36][cH:35]2)[n:7][c:8]2[c:13]1[CH2:12][CH2:11][CH2:10][CH2:9]2)[CH:29]1[CH2:30][CH2:31][CH2:32][CH2:33][CH2:34]1)[NH:17][c:18]1[c:19](F)[cH:20][c:21](-[c:22]2[n:23][n:24][n:25][nH:26]2)[cH:27][cH:28]1

So this template indeed transforms a fluorine aromatic to chlorine aromatic, with amine involvement. That seems like SNAr (halide replaced). The product has Cl, reactant has F. So the template is a halogen exchange? But SNAr typically replaces halide with nucleophile, not halogen exchange. However the template may be generic.

Given the precursor list from earlier (make_8_lvl2-apply_template-2) gave a single SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)Nc1ccccc1F". This contains a phenyl-F attached to sulfonamide nitrogen. The product after SNAr would be phenyl-Cl? Actually the template above replaces F with Cl, but our precursor has F, not Cl. The product would have Cl? The target molecule likely has Cl (leaving group) replaced by amine, resulting in F? Not sure.

But the template ID for this entry is reaction_id 639229. The template_id likely is the reaction_id? The task says "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash) as an integer". So we can use reaction_id as template_id.
